title: Using psychological theory to ground guidelines for the annotation of misogynistic language

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot prompting of LLMs (Llama 3.3, Mistral Large, Qwen2) to classify Reddit posts and Ambivalent Sexism Inventory items as 'misogynistic' or 'non-misogynistic' under different annotation guideline conditions. The models' performance is evaluated using precision, recall, F1 scores, and Bayesian Logistic Mixed Effects Regression to reveal systematic underperformance and inbuilt biases regarding nuanced or subtle forms of misogyny.
